crossRefs.note: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, opposite the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.
Joab sent to Tekoa, and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on…
The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of…
‘Curse Meroz,’ said Yahweh’s angel. ‘Curse bitterly its inhabitants, because they didn’t come to help Yahweh, to help…
Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know the Yahweh’s way, nor the law of their God.
I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of Yahweh, and the law of their God.” But…
For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
Charge those who are rich in this present world that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty…
that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;
Yahweh says to me: “Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck.
“ ‘ “ ‘It will happen that I will punish the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king…

but they will serve Yahweh their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.

people.name: Tekoa
people.line: Town in Judah, home of the prophet Amos

translations.web: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the Lord’s work.
translations.bsb: Next to him, the Tekoites made repairs, but their nobles did not put their shoulders to the work under their supervisors.
translations.kjv: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.
translations.asv: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their lord.
